title: MTXWynncraft
description: Minimal Wynncraft modpack with essential performance and QoL mods.
body:
Minimal Wynncraft modpack focused on performance and QoL. Includes essential mods like Sodium, Lithium, Iris, and Wynn utilities for a smooth, optimized experience. Perfect for both beginners and advanced players :)

## Performance & Optimization:

- Sodium — FPS boost and rendering optimization
- Lithium — Improves game physics and logic performance
- FerriteCore — Reduces RAM usage
- Sodium Extra — Additional graphics settings
- Reese’s Sodium Options — Better settings UI for Sodium

## Visuals:

- Iris — Shader support
- Freelook — Free camera movement
- Voxy — LoD to achieve far distance rendering

## Wynncraft Mods:

- Wynntils — Main Wynncraft enhancement mod (UI, map, tracking)
- WynnBuild — Build export integration
- Wynnventory — Trademarket data, lootrun and raid lootpools
- Wynncraft Spell Caster — Simplifies spell casting
- Wynnmod — Additional utilities and overlays
- Voices of Wynn — Adds voice acting to quests

## QoL & Interface:

- Mod Menu — In-game mod list and settings
- Cloth Config — Config menu support
- Mouse Tweaks — Better inventory controls
- Just Zoom — Zoom functionality

## Dependencies:

- Fabric API — Core modding library
- Placeholder API — Required for some mods
- Konkrete — Library dependency
